svg.title: WHICH OPTION FITS THE DEPOT?
svg.desc: Left-to-right decision flow for a 40-bus school depot requiring about 4,000 kWh daily. First compare spare grid power times 12 overnight hours with need; if sufficient select managed charging. Otherwise compare spare power times 24 hours; if sufficient select stationary battery on the existing service; otherwise consider bringing energy in. Three example capacities and a winter demand note are included.

g.text: Example depot: 40 buses, daily need about 4,000 kWh
B. BATTERY ON THE EXISTING SERVICE
Charge a battery during the day,
Winter can double the need to about 8,000 kWh a day —
then even the 400 kW site needs a battery.
First-pass screen. Ignores battery round-trip losses, existing site loads and charger power limits.
AXIVAI estimates. Need = 40 buses × 60 mi × 1.5 kWh/mi ÷ 90%.
